tools.name: generate_available_domains
tools.description: Generate niche-tailored domain name ideas (personal email, newsletter, homelab, portfolio, 5-letter brandable, SaaS/AI, domain hacks, e-commerce, etc.) and verify live DNS availability via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1. Returns available domains with first-year promo codes and direct registration checkout link

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check live DNS availability for up to 100 specific domain names in parallel and get verified first-year registration promo codes + direct checkout links.

tools.name: inspect_domain_dns_whois
tools.description: Inspect live DNS propagation (A, AAAA, www CNAME, MX, SPF, DMARC, NS via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DoH) and ICANN RDAP WHOIS registration/expiration dates for any domain.

tools.name: get_verified_domain_coupons
tools.description: Retrieve verified active Namecheap promo codes and flash sales for domains (.COM $5.98, .STORE $0.98, $0.99 TLDs), EasyWP WordPress, Shared Hosting, Private Email, and FastVPN.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_verified_domain_coupons · Private data: get_verified_domain_coupons · Public sink: generate_available_domains, get_verified_domain_coupons.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_verified_domain_coupons · Private data: get_verified_domain_coupons · Public sink: generate_available_domains, get_verified_domain_coupons

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
